company.name: LowKick Studio
company.shortDescription: Game development studio based in UAE working on PC/Mobile games.
company.description:
PC/Mobile games development studio, based in Abu-Dhabi, UAE.

* Our team has gathered people with rich experience in creating high-grossing games. Many of us have worked for companies such as Playrix, Wargaming, Gaijin Entertainment, G5 Entertainment, Game Insight, Social Quantum, Nival, Innova and others. And we bundled together to make a new game – a game that millions of players will love. We are result-oriented professionals, and we know how successful games are being made. 

* We are not going to slow down, much less stop after the game's release. Our project WorldShards is what we are going to dedicate the next years of our work in the game industry to. We are confident that we have everything we need to do this: the right people, a clear plan, and a vision for the project that surpasses anything we've ever done before.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $1,475,000, or 56.73% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,075,145 to $13,307,014, a 1.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 42 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 39 (-13).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
